mission.title: No Animals Were Harmed
mission.description: Escort Hyene and the EMCP prototypes to test them on the General's commandos.

npc.say: This reminds me of some work I did with Silver. Fun times!
Don't worry, I'm quite certain we've taken care of that little feedback problem.

phase.briefing:
I have excellent news for you, {player}. My invention is ready for testing. The EMCP device shall reveal the true weakness of the General and his men.
Now, I need you to pick up Hyene. He has some of the prototypes, ready for testing.

enter.say: Meet up with Hyene and lead him out of here.

talk.say: Hey, {player}. Show the way, and we'll open a can of EMCP lovin' on those tin soldiers.

objective.text: Lead Hyene out of the area

phase.briefing: Now that you have Hyene in tow, proceed to the indicated location. We've tracked some of those commandos there; I think they're just waiting for someone to come ruin their days. Hop to it!

enter.say: I'm reading a ton of signals in there. Keep on your toes!

complete.say:
Magnificent! Did you see them go down? Just as planned...
All right, I need you to get Hyene on to another location. Get him out of there.

phase.briefing:
Just a little further testing, and my little devices will be ready for real use!
Get over to the next location and let them have it.

enter.say: One more to go... let's find 'em and let loose with this thing!
Looks pretty much like the last phase -- plenty of signals.

done.say: Nice, looks like... whoa! Looks like Hyene got hit by that one too! You'd better get him out of there!

phase.briefing:
Come to think of it, one of the scientists did mention something about "feedback"... very interesting. You'd better get Hyene over to one of our labs, for study of the, ah, things that... ah...
Well, you probably wouldn't understand. Just take him to Raccoon, all right?

enter.say: Are we there yet? I feel kinda weak...
According to my readings, Raccoon is on site.

done.say: Well, I'm sure they can work out the details. Before you get out of there, make sure you have at least three inventory slots open... I have a little surprise for you.

near.say: Did Hyene make it? Is he with you?

complete.say: We'll be sure to put a note in the user manual about this little issue.
I suspect this was nothing more than user error.
I... I don't think I did anything wrong! It just went off...
I'll have the scientists take a look at that feedback issue.
